shots.detail_en: Quote hook: total black frame, a single line of voice dropped into darkness.
shots.sub: 熊（画外）：我从来没有做错过任何事。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: The Xiong study lights up: before a wall of old photos, Xiong Tiancheng stands with hands behind his back; Xiong Wei waits at the door.
shots.sub: 熊伟：这话您说了三十年。今晚——我用您的数据，替您数一数。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Xiong Wei turns his laptop toward his father: a thirty-year win-rate curve running perfectly straight up.
shots.sub: 熊伟：胜率 99.4%。父亲，市场里——有这么直的东西吗？
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Xiong Tiancheng laughs; the Buddha beads stall between his fingers.
shots.sub: 熊：直，因为我修剪过。 熊伟：做错的记录，您都删了。
shots.speaker: XIONG+XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Xiong Wei pulls up the deletion log: screens of 'purged' entries scrolling like a barrage of subtitles.
shots.sub: 熊伟：您没有做错过任何事——因为做错的账，都被您烧了。模型管这个叫：造神。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: For the first time, Xiong Tiancheng's smile stiffens for half a second.
shots.sub: 熊：你在拆我的庙。 熊伟：我在升级它。庙拆了，神才挪得动位子。
shots.speaker: XIONG+XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Xiong Tiancheng turns his back on his son and gazes at the city lights outside.
shots.sub: 熊：伟儿，想坐那把椅子，直说。 熊伟：我不要椅子。我要所有椅子上的人——按我的模型坐。
shots.speaker: XIONG+XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Across town, in the stairwell of old Zhou's home block, Man Cang stands at the door with a fruit basket; sobs leak from inside.
shots.sub: 满仓：老周叔……对不住，对不住……
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Crouched in the stairwell, Man Cang holds a hand-drawn 'rumor route' map he traced himself, finger moving up cell by cell.
shots.sub: 满仓：谣言这东西比全仓还狠——全仓赔的是钱，它赔的是命。三楼散的，二楼接的……最后指回联华贵宾席。
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: The last cell of the map: a standing-position mark — the second-floor window spot where Changhong always stands.
shots.sub: 不会的……不会是他……
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Blast point: on the brokerage rooftop, Changhong holds out the deposit slip — principal plus interest.
shots.sub: 长：六万，外加三成——K 线里它只是一根毫毛。替我给伯父。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Man Cang stares at the slip, does not take it, and asks first.
shots.sub: 满仓：你先回答我——老周叔的票，风是不是你放的？
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Changhong is silent for three seconds and does not deny it.
shots.sub: 长：……我做局，只做姓熊的局。 满：风又不认人！它吹倒的全是老周叔这样的人！
shots.speaker: CH+MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Man Cang pushes the slip back, very gently.
shots.sub: 满仓：钱先拿着。现在还了，还的是我爹的牙口——可我兄弟那边，得先有个说法。
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Changhong grips the slip, for the first time finding no words.
shots.sub: 长：满仓，你再信我一次—— 满（打断）：我信你。可老周叔，也得有人信。
shots.speaker: CH+MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Archive room: Hongli slaps the stitched ledger page in front of Changhong.
shots.sub: 红：熊天成给你的是裁缝账。这一针，是他儿子机房里缝出来的——父子俩，在抢着喂你真相。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Hongli steps closer; for the first time her voice trembles.
shots.sub: 红：账目我替你看了十年，看它从记分板，变成屠刀。陆长虹，你父亲跳下去之前——
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Changhong's head snaps up.
shots.sub: ……最怕什么？
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Hongli stares at him for two seconds, grabs her coat and turns to leave.
shots.sub: 红：这句话，等你自己配听的时候——我再说完。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Changhong chases to the door and stops; the glass door reflects him and the green board light behind.
shots.sub: 长：沈红利——！
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Top-floor photo wall: Xiong Tiancheng hangs a brand-new empty picture frame.
shots.sub: 熊：老陆，位置留好了。就差他，亲手把恨挂上来。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Black frame end card for next episode.
shots.sub: 她没说完的那半句——十年前，另一个人也听过。
shots.card: 她没说完的那半句——十年前，另一个人也听过。
